_note: Operationalisation of RULE.md (commit ebabf7e) written before any corpus search. Forms are consonants after removing non-letters and folding final letters (ך>כ ם>מ ן>נ ף>פ ץ>צ). Matching is on morphological parts (prefixes ו ב ל ה ש מ כ are separate parts in both ETCBC corpora); the 4 direction nouns are also matched with up to 3 unsplit prefix letters. Forms are those listed in the rule plus extra spellings of the same lexemes attested in ETCBC 3Q15; the homograph אמת (also 'truth') is left out of the main run and tried as a variant.
number_word: next morphological part after the measure part (same graphical word or first part of next graphical word) is a numeral sign (DSS sign type numr or Hebrew cantillation-marked numeral letters), or is tagged numeral (DSS sp=numr; BHSA ls=card), or its consonants match the cardinal list regex
main_reading: hit = window of 12 consecutive graphical words with >=3 distinct classes among CUBIT, DIG, TALENT, SILVER, GOLD, VESSEL, DIRECTION, NUM (NUM = a number directly after a measure), and at least one measure in the window directly followed by a number. The 4 directions are one class (slash notation in the rule = alternant spellings).
strict_variant: as main but NUM does not count toward the 3 distinct classes (3 lexical classes needed, one of them a measure followed by a number)
other_variants: V_rec: ignore parts with half or more of their letters inside modern reconstruction brackets (DSS only)
V_dir4: directions as four separate classes
shuffle: 1000 permutations of the fragment's graphical words (random.Random(20261027 + unit index)); p = (k+1)/1001 where k = permutations in which the signature appears
hit_counting: hit loci = maximal runs of overlapping qualifying windows; base rate = loci per 10,000 graphical words
